#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue appears to be caused by the BASE_URL constant defaulting to "http://localhost:3000" when the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. This results in the password reset email containing links to localhost instead of the correct production or staging URL.

To resolve this, please verify that the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is correctly set in your deployment environment. If it is set and the problem persists, we may need to investigate further how environment variables are loaded or consider a fallback mechanism for the BASE_URL constant.
